label: SYNTHETIC
note: Recipient matcher golden vectors (A710; REQ-AMB-003, INV-21). Every name is invented. Both the Go matcher (services/core/evidence/recipientmatch) and the Python reference (services/model/tests/test_matcher_vectors.py) load this file, build their matcher from packs/fintech/lexicons/recipient_matcher.json, and must give the same exact fraction (numerator over denominator, in lowest terms) for every case. The expected values were produced by the Python reference matcher (the authority); a Go result that differs is a Go defect. A phonetic case is scored with the voice-path tier enabled (the request has no phonetic member, so the production adapter never enables it). The data file's tiers, folding, nicknames and variants are the matcher's only name knowledge. A case with a dataset member is scored with that inline matcher data (every tier score distinct, so each tier is told apart) instead of the shipped file.

distinct_tiers.note: Recipient-name matcher data for the D5 composed matcher (DEC-2026-10-20). Every entry is a [synthetic seed]: invented for the POC, not reviewed by a native speaker (PERD REQ-INT-003 dependency), and the tier scores are starting values to be set by a benchmark run and a founder decision, not tuned values.
